findings.description: The delimiter row under the #66 counts table has ten columns, but the header and every data row have nine. GitHub-flavored Markdown only treats a block as a table when the delimiter row's column count matches the header, so the before/after generation and upload counts show up as raw pipe-separated text in the architecture docs.
findings.title: Overlay evidence table renders as plain text

findings.description: The wind skip path adds three per-cell hash updates to `validate_values` for every wind solve, and the PR's measurements cover only headless generation and upload counts. The docs record that the macOS window probe got no draw callbacks, so alternating 50× window frame time, P95 publication frame, and marker-maintenance cost were never measured. Without those numbers, the net benefit of the wind marker on the player's desktop workload is inferred from counts alone, and a regression in frame time would go unnoticed.
findings.title: Wind-overlay frame cost and marker cost are unmeasured
